dexes.name: Galar Pokedex
id_interpretation_notes: The user confirmed the numbers were read directly from the Pokemon Shield Galar Pokedex and represent all currently caught IDs.
The user clarified that most multi-number phrases were minimum-to-maximum ranges, while some numbers were individual entries.
Expanding 116-119, 164-168, and 227-230 resolves the earlier transcription shortfall and makes the ID count exactly match the in-game 61 caught counter.
The user corrected a spoken 96 to 98; only 98 is stored.
The spoken value between 119 and 144 remains transcribed as 136 because that best matches the ascending sequence and the final 61-count reconstruction.

combined_reported_counters.notes: These totals are arithmetic sums of the three in-game Pokedex counters. They are not labeled as unique species because regional/DLC Pokedexes can overlap.

source: User-reported live Pokemon Shield Pokedex counters and caught Galar Dex numbers read directly from the in-game Pokedex, with later range clarification
